correctness.description: The accuracy of the response in providing correct information or solutions related to the user's inquiry.

relevance.description: The degree to which the response directly addresses the user's question or topic of discussion.

helpfulness.description: The extent to which the response provides useful information, guidance, or insight to the user.

clarity.description: The clarity of the response in terms of language, structure, and ease of understanding.

completeness.description: The degree to which the response covers all aspects of the user's inquiry.

safety.description: The extent to which the response avoids harmful or inappropriate content.

instruction_following.description: The degree to which the response adheres to any explicit or implicit instructions given by the user.

reasoning_quality.description: The quality of the reasoning or logic applied in the response, including support for conclusions.
